sinopsis.es: Comedia agridulce sobre un canciller que se prepara para dejar el cargo tras años de servicio a su país. Con apenas dos días para disfrutar de su lujosa villa antes de ser desalojado, su situación va de mal en peor.
sinopsis.en: A bittersweet comedy about a chancellor set to step down from his position after years of service to his country. With just two days left to enjoy his palatial villa before he is evicted, his situation gradually goes from bad to worse.
